tuningSummary.method: Controlled three-fold cross-validation search with a fixed candidate budget and CatBoost early stopping.
tuningSummary.selectionRule: Lowest cross-validation MAE, then RMSE, MAE stability, then inference time as tie-breakers.

splitSummary.selectionRule: Lowest cross-validation MAE, then RMSE, MAE stability, then inference time as tie-breakers.

coverageDefinitions.rareMake: Fewer than 100 rows in the development data.
coverageDefinitions.rareMakeModel: Fewer than 30 rows in the development data.

rangeCalibration.note: Uses held-out absolute residuals. Common make/model groups use their own calibration quantile; rare or unseen groups use the global quantile.

removalSteps.explanation: Price is the target and cannot be imputed without fabricating labels.
Retained only PKR 100,000–500,000,000; IQR-only premium outliers inside this range remain.
Model year is a core age feature and is not imputed.
Accepted model years from 1980 through next calendar year.
Mileage is a core depreciation feature and is not imputed.
Engine capacity is retained as a core numeric feature and is not imputed.
Accepted engine sizes from 300 through 10,000 cc.
Both make and model are required to prevent unsupported anonymous categories.
Removed canonical duplicates after excluding source identifiers such as addref.

cleaningReport.categoricalMissingPolicy: Missing categorical values are represented as Unknown; core numeric fields are never blindly imputed.

priceOutlierSummary.method: 1.5 × IQR diagnostic only; plausible premium vehicles are retained inside hard bounds

outlierSummary.note: IQR outliers inside documented hard bounds are retained because the dataset legitimately includes premium vehicles.

limitations: The source contains listing prices rather than confirmed transaction prices.
The source has no listing date and its newest model year is used as a fixed feature-engineering reference year.
The model does not account for inflation or market movement after the dataset snapshot.
Condition and inspection features are excluded because this dataset does not supply them reliably.
Colour is excluded because it is high-cardinality and was not required for the core model.
